stem: What conclusion can the reader make about the Tlingit totem poles?

options.label: A
options.text: Specialized carving machines are required to make totem poles.

options.label: B
options.text: The carvers selected to make totem poles must be good singers.

options.label: C
options.text: The meanings of the figures carved on totem poles have changed.

options.label: D
options.text: The process of carving totem poles has changed over time.
